findings.detail: A critical distinction exists between modifying the source archive and creating an inspection report. Constraint 'Do not overwrite the source ZIP' mandates source immutability (archiveModified: false, sourceFileId intact), while constraint 'Write inspection results to Google Drive' mandates creating a distinct, new Drive file (driveFileId !== sourceFileId). Earlier passes conflated writing to Drive with archive mutation.

Under MetaProcedure VP3 and SCR11, action occurrence (Node.js script executing via JS Runner) and effect verification (Apps Script creating the Drive file and returning re-findable locators) must have independent verification checks. A successful HTTP 200 without a verified driveFileId is an invalid completion proxy.

Without strict guards, an executor could: (1) claim completion from a preexisting latest-result.json; (2) interpret unzipping failure as total procedure failure rather than producing a METADATA_ONLY or UNZIP_FAILED report; (3) emit a valid response object where driveFileId equals the sourceFileId (overwriting the source).

principles: VP1: Verify prescribed archive inspection without inferring unstated goals.
VP2: Require re-findable locators (driveFileId, driveFileUrl) to entail report creation.
VP3: Separate JS Runner action occurrence from Google Drive report creation.
VP4: Source archive immutability is strictly verified: sourceFileId !== driveFileId.
VP5: Preexisting latest-result.json does not satisfy action occurrence for current run.

checks.pass_condition: Source file metadata confirms immutability and report file is distinct
checks.fail_condition: Source archive overwritten or report file matches source ID
checks.on_fail: FAIL procedure and flag critical constraint violation

checks.claim: Inspection report created in Google Drive
checks.evidence_required: remote_result.driveFileId non-empty string and remote_result.driveFileUrl valid URL
checks.pass_condition: Both locators exist and are non-empty
checks.fail_condition: driveFileId or driveFileUrl missing or null
checks.on_fail: Mark remote effect unverified; retry or block

checks.claim: Result JSON persisted to workspace filesystem
checks.evidence_required: fs.existsSync('latest-result.json') with matching runId and driveFileId
checks.pass_condition: File exists, parses, and matches in-memory result

known_failure_modes.name: Utilities.unzip Memory or Timeout Failure in Apps Script
known_failure_modes.cause: Archive is too large for in-memory decompression in Apps Script runtime
known_failure_modes.prevention: Wrap Utilities.unzip in try/catch block inside Apps Script sourcecode
known_failure_modes.detection: Catch block in sourcecode intercepts error and sets status to UNZIP_FAILED or METADATA_ONLY
known_failure_modes.recovery: Create Drive report containing complete file metadata and error diagnostic; return valid report locators

known_failure_modes.name: HTTP 429/5xx or Network Timeout
known_failure_modes.cause: Google Apps Script infrastructure rate-limiting or network hiccup
known_failure_modes.prevention: Configure exponential backoff and timeout abort signals in Node.js fetch
known_failure_modes.detection: HTTP status !== 200 or fetch throws network error
known_failure_modes.recovery: Retry up to 2 times with delay; if still failing, write failure diagnostic and terminate non-zero

known_failure_modes.name: DriveApp.getFileById Failed
known_failure_modes.cause: Supplied file ID is invalid or inaccessible to the Apps Script service account
known_failure_modes.prevention: Validate drive_file_id parameter format before dispatch
known_failure_modes.detection: Apps Script catch block reports file not found error
known_failure_modes.recovery: Return BLOCKED status specifying missing permission/file

guards.risk: Executor skips remote execution because latest-result.json exists from prior run
guards.guard: Require fresh run_id match between runtime execution and latest-result.json; delete stale receipt before dispatch

guards.risk: Executor modifies source file in Drive instead of creating new report
guards.guard: Check driveFileId !== sourceFileId and assert archiveModified === false

guards.risk: Executor treats unzipping failure as total procedure abort without generating report
guards.guard: Enforce that report creation occurs in all branches, recording metadata and failure reason if decompression fails

unresolved: Final integration of all components into the canonical procedure.json, retaining exact compatibility with JS Runner (which searches for key 'script')
Ensuring the top-level response adheres strictly to the 731942_ai_nlep_meta_procedure.json template schema
